cls: Messing with key frame detection has a pretty big blast radius (as we saw recently with some SEI parsing changes), so we'll want this guarded behind a flag.
most of this code is not needed for any slices except for IDR, I think it's time to split `case H264NALU::kNonIDRSlice:` from the rest of the cases.
I think it would be a bit more elegant to check the feature flag here. ``` bool allow_bare_idr = !base::FeatureList::IsEnabled(kH264IDRKeyframeRequiresParameterSets) ||…
